name: Pure Magnetik
description: Founded in 2006, Pure Magnetik is a Brooklyn-based company that creates creative music tools and pioneering sound recordings. Originally established as a premier sound design company collaborating with Ableton AG in Berlin, the company expanded in 2016 to develop unique software plugins using the open-source Csound audio language. In 2018, Pure Magnetik launched its music label focusing on experimental and ambient genres.
